tagline: Beier取景器相机，1970 年发布
description: Beier于1970年推出的取景器相机。配备Meyer Trioplan 1:3.5/45mm or Ludwig Meritar 1:2.8/45mm。快门速度Junior-II, Modell II or Priomat with speeds 30, 60, 125, and B。使用35mm。

specs.快门: Junior-II, Modell II or Priomat with speeds 30, 60, 125, and B
specs.取景器: optical, early versions were ocular shiftable for parallax correction
specs.英文简介: Beirette was a name applied to a long sequence of compact 35mm viewfinder camera models, made from 1958 to the 1980s in East Germany by Beier.
